Subject: MAP: security gating & evidence timeline (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m sending over a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that scopes the security/compliance gates we need to close for production access. Top-line asks: SOC 2 snapshot, SIG/CAIQ baseline, signed DPA (our latest redline attached), and a data-retention alignment for EU/US workloads.

I attached a compact MAP workbook with owners and suggested dates. Can you confirm FinVault’s preferred evidence owners (security team contact for SOC 2, legal contact for DPA) and whether a two-week acceptance window on final evidence is workable for you?

Quick notes in advance:
- We’ll provide a SOC 2:2024 snapshot and control mapping (Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf).
- SIG/CAIQ: we can provide the completed CAIQ and an annotated response set in 3 business days once you confirm the scope.
- DPA: I attached our redline (Attachment: DPA-redline.docx). If you have material changes, let us know and we’ll coordinate legal review.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), SOC2-snapshot.pdf, DPA-redline.docx

Proposed milestones (summary):
1) Confirm evidence owners — by 2027-07-23
2) CAIQ complete & evidence intake — by 2027-07-27
3) DPA negotiated & signed — by 2027-08-03
4) Final acceptance & production enablement — by 2027-08-10

If those dates don’t fit your calendar we can tighten/relax. Happy to jump on a short call to walk the MAP with your security and legal teams.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

2) CAIQ: can you indicate which components you consider non-applicable up-front? Our assessment team prefers a short N/A list to speed review.
3) DPA redline: Legal will flag any data residency carve-outs. Can you state whether Redwood requires any escrow or third-party processor exceptions?

Owner notes: I’ll be the primary coordinator but will loop John Patel (Head of InfoSec) and our GC, Maria Gomez, once we have the MAP workbook in HubSpot.

We can accept your proposed schedule tentatively; I’ll confirm owners by EOD Friday (2027-07-23).
